description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document. Arrange the files in any order, preview each file's page count, then merge and download the result.

faqs.a: Yes. Merging only appends whole documents in the order you choose. No pages are reordered, resized or altered inside each file.
faqs.q: Will merging change the content of my PDFs?

faqs.a: Use the up and down arrow buttons next to each file to move it, or the × button to remove it from the list.
faqs.q: How do I change the order of the files?

faqs.a: Everything happens locally in your browser using the PDF-Lib engine. Files are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Click "Choose PDF files" and select two or more PDF files.
Use the ↑ and ↓ buttons to arrange them in the order you want, or × to remove one.
Check each file's page count shown next to its name.
Click "Merge PDFs" and the combined file downloads automatically.
title: PDF Merger
